caseName: Mallo v. West Virginia Department of Health & Human Resources
caseNameFull: Carolyn Mallo v. West Virginia Department of Health and Human Resources

opinions.text: Motion for leave to file a petition for writ of certiorari under seal denied without prejudice to filing a renewed motion together with either a redacted petition for writ of certiorari, or an explanation as to why the petition may not be redacted, within 30 days.
